messages:
mike: Quick follow-up from the PM: persistent shard slow leak postmortem — we need a clear list of remediation owners and ETA. Obs: steady allocation growth in kv-residency over 3 days. Anyone picking up profiling? 

anya: I'll take profiling and initial hypotheses. Will run full heapwalk + jemalloc stats on the canary fleet tomorrow. ETA EOD Thu. 

sasha: assigned. I'll collect alloc traces and look at slab fragmentation patterns. quick findings: ```heapwalk summary: shard=42 residency=+1.3MB/min top-alloc-sites: libkv.cc:452, kv_cache.cpp:1184``` 

mike: awesome. Can you share diff of jemalloc stats when you have them? also add a flamegraph if possible. 

sasha: will do. Also saw increased retention after GC compaction windows — might be ineffective compaction at 4k slab size. 

rcarroll: I'll own limits/guardrails — plan: softlimit bump + eviction-frequency increase as temporary mitigation. Action: deploy softlimit + canary eviction tweak by Fri 12:00 PST. 

anya: Adding instrumentation: expose per-shard residency histogram and fragmentation ratio to /metrics. PR coming. 

ops-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout started for kv-softlimit-fix on 3 nodes (canary-1..3). link: https://ci.internal/build/999 

mike: For longer term: schedule a GC tuning spike — propose: 2-week spike to evaluate slab sizes, compaction thresholds, and jemalloc purge options. Need owners and success criteria. 

anya: I'll draft spike plan today. Success criteria proposal: 1) sustained >30% reduction in per-shard leak slope in 7d perf runs, 2) no latency regressions >5th percentile, 3) clear mitigations to roll into runtime. 

sasha: profiling checklist I'll own: heapwalk, jemalloc stats, per-shard live set, flamegraphs, and KV allocation site tagging. 

rcarroll: Guardrail checklist: (a) softlimit canary, (b) eviction policy change, (c) emergency OOM alerting rule (pager if mem > 90% for 3m). I'll open the Jira with those tasks. 

mike: please add timelines to the ticket comments. Also set weekly check-in channel thread for progress. 

anya: Created ticket RW-5123 and added initial tasks + owners. Link: https://jira.redwood/RW-5123 

sasha: Uploading artifacts to the postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/persistent-shard-2447990000. I'll include flamegraphs + jemalloc diffs. 

mike: great. Final action items recap: 
- profiling: @sasha — heapwalk + flamegraphs (ETA Thu EOD) 
- instrumentation: @anya — per-shard metrics (PR in 24h) 
- guardrails: @rcarroll — softlimit canary + eviction tweak (Fri noon) 
- spike plan: @anya & @mike — 2-week GC tuning spike (draft today) 
- alerts: @rcarroll — emergency pager rule (today) 

mike: If anyone hits blockers ping me or drop in #eng-runtime; we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
